email_subject: Application - UI Design System & Information Architecture Internship
email_body:
Dear HMS Networks Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI Design System & Information Architecture Internship. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design and front-end development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global industrial platform's design system.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, build and maintain WordPress sites, and analyze performance data. My experience with AngularJS as a front-end developer, combined with my hands-on work on mirook.com where I implemented structured data and technical audits, has given me a solid understanding of component-driven design and the importance of clear documentation.

I am curious, organized, and eager to learn, and I thrive in structured environments. I am particularly drawn to this role because it offers the chance to work directly with a senior Information Architect and develop a scalable Figma component library and handover framework. I am comfortable asking questions, documenting clearly, and presenting work-in-progress to cross-functional teams.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am available for the full internship duration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm align with your team's goals.

Thank you for considering my application.

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear HMS Networks Team,

I am excited to apply for the UI Design System & Information Architecture Internship. Your description of shaping the future of a global industrial platform through design resonates deeply with my background and aspirations. With a technical foundation in web design and front-end development, combined with my current work in digital marketing, I am eager to bring my analytical mindset and structured approach to your team.

In my role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site building. I am accustomed to working within structured workflows and collaborating with cross-functional teams. My previous experience as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, where I worked with AngularJS and JavaScript, gave me direct exposure to component-driven development and the importance of clear handoffs between design and development.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I have applied technical SEO and GEO audits, implemented structured data, and optimized for AI-powered search engines. This project has taught me to extract, structure, and synthesize information effectively—skills that are directly relevant to analyzing and documenting design systems.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work under a senior Information Architect and contribute to a production-grade design environment. I am comfortable asking questions, documenting clearly, and presenting work-in-progress. I am also familiar with Lean UX and SAFe methodologies from my coursework and self-study, and I am eager to apply them in a real-world setting.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am available for the full internship duration. I am confident that my curiosity, diligence, and technical aptitude will allow me to make a meaningful contribution to your team while growing professionally.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your design system initiatives.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
